name: Close Settings
description: Close policy the Close Lead owns (konsol#305 P13). EPM Settings stays System Manager only.

fields.label: First Close Fiscal Year
fields.description: The first period konsol closes. Earlier periods are history (opening balances). No default: sign-off and period close are refused until this is declared (konsol#303).

fields.label: Self-Approval
fields.description: Whether the person who prepared a document may approve it. No default: until declared, a self-approval is refused and sign-off lists the gap (konsol#305-D2-3).

fields.label: Rate Move Needing a Reason
fields.description: A group rate that moves more than this from the previous approved rate or the ERP quote needs a Reason for Change. No default; 0 is undeclared (konsol#305-D2-9).

fields.label: Intercompany
fields.description: Blank: intercompany is expected, or not set up yet (My work shows 'No intercompany accounts declared' until an Intercompany Account is Published). None in this group: no intercompany is expected; the intercompany screen, My work and the sign-off read 'not applicable'. Refused while any Intercompany Account is Published. No default (konsol#305-W3-7).

fields.label: CTA account
fields.description: The balance-sheet account the consolidated balance sheet shows currency translation (CTA) under. No default: blank shows the CTA in the unmatched residual.

fields.label: Current-year result account
fields.description: The balance-sheet account the consolidated balance sheet shows the profit or loss to date under. No default.
